name: Breitenbach am Inn
kurzbeschreibung: Warm and welcoming village of Inn with its Baroque church and the lovely hiking area Breitenbacher Wald.
beschreibung:
Breitenbach am Inn lies at an elevation of 520 meters in the Tiroler Unterland, just a few kilometers west of Kufstein, directly on the Inn tributary of the same name. As a market town with around 3,500 inhabitants, the place belongs to the district of Kufstein and forms a quiet contrast to the nearby fortress town. Its location at the transition from the Inntal into the gentler foothills of the Wilder Kaiser makes the town a practical starting point between valley and mountain.

The heart of the hiking region is the Breitenbacher Wald, an extensive, close-to-nature forest area that is especially popular with families and leisure hikers thanks to marked trails and a well-signposted circular route. In the town itself stands the Baroque parish church, whose striking facade shapes the village scene. Those seeking silence will find it on the narrow paths along the Breitenbach, which gives the town its name. The proximity to Kufstein also makes it possible to take excursions to the fortress or into the Kaisergebirgs-Welt without having to give up the peace of the village.

The food scene is typical of the Unterinntal, with down-to-earth inns serving regional cuisine such as Kasnocken or Tiroler Gröstl. 🏘️ Breitenbach am Inn is not a place for grand staging, but rather impresses with the honest interplay of village everyday life, close-to-nature recreation, and quick access to the urban infrastructure of Kufstein.
